title: PARALLAX and DREAMSTATE V2 evidence science upgrade
summary: PARALLAX V2 binds action/regime/comparison contracts into immutable decision identity, preserves causal-time and immutable branch-plan protections, requires evidence-complete paired paths, isolates source revisions/contracts/branch parameters, adds context strata, richer target/compound twins, non-pooled regret, bounded UI screening snapshots, and Benjamini-Hochberg FDR control. DREAMSTATE V2 consumes the complete internal hypothesis screen, isolates families by revision/contract, adds target and compound hypotheses, policy contracts, family search accounting, source-decay retirement, re-checks current PARALLAX evidence immediately before any gate update, and enforces stronger gate preconditions. All authority remains research/shadow only.
evidence: PR #87 causal-time and immutable branch-plan protections preserved
comparison-contract identity and backward-compatible SQLite migration
paired evidence completeness and branch-parameter isolation
Benjamini-Hochberg FDR screen within exact evidence families
regret and ablation isolation by comparable evidence scope
one active candidate per family and 12-trial budget
DREAMSTATE gate updates revalidate the exact current PARALLAX source hypothesis
PARALLAX UI screening snapshot is bounded while DREAMSTATE consumes the complete internal hypothesis set
